title: HostCover Income-Loss Claims: Guest Payments and the Deductible by Level, Training Questions
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover).** The income recovery-sharing method follows the plan level and decides how the guest payments recorded on the income-loss claim, net of reversals, are shared between Roamhaven and the host.

**What is subtracted on HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite or HostCover Estate?** The guest payments first restore the deductible the income-loss claim bears, so only the larger of those payments and that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted lost income.

**And on HostCover Standard or HostCover Plus?** The guest payments are shared in proportion to the parts of the loss each side bears: the deductible is subtracted from the adjusted lost income together with the guest payments multiplied by the adjusted lost income less the deductible (never below 0.00) and divided by the adjusted lost income.

**On any other level?** On HostCover Essential the guest payments and the deductible are both subtracted from the adjusted lost income.

**What is the adjusted lost income?** The lost income being settled, before guest payments and the deductible come off it.

**Which guest payments count?** Every guest payment recorded on the income-loss claim, less reversals by the guest's card issuer.

**Worked through (hypothetical): adjusted lost income 1600.00, guest payments 200.00, deductible 80.00.**

| Level | Subtracted | Left |
|---|---|---|
| HostCover Premier, Elite, Estate | 200.00 (the larger of 200.00 and 80.00) | 1400.00 |
| HostCover Standard, Plus | 80.00 plus 200.00 multiplied by 1520.00 and divided by 1600.00 (190.00): 270.00 | 1330.00 |
| HostCover Essential | 200.00 plus 80.00: 280.00 | 1320.00 |
